<h2>Collect sjSDM Tuning Stage Timings</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Converts compact fold prediction caches into a long timing table for fold
preparation, fitting, prediction, and scoring stages.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_sjsdm_tuning_timings(list_prediction_cache = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_prediction_cache">list_prediction_cache</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold caches returned by [run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()] when prediction
caching is enabled.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Long tibble with repeat, fold, optional candidate, stage, elapsed seconds,
and execution status.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
summarise_sjsdm_tuning_timings(list_sjsdm_tuning_prediction_cache)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
